notes.title: LavaWorks launches new video game GORILLA SMASH game on Steam
notes.content: [p][/p][p]100 men verses one gorilla simulations have been making the rounds on social media posts and viral videos so now USA based LavaWorks takes your wonder of the answering that question into the world of interactive gameplay.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="qhrhVVeRt8I;leftthumb"][/previewyoutube][p]One of a kind player capabilities as a Gorilla takes you through a maze of levels to see how you'd fare to beat the recent theoretical trendy meme quandary to see who would win.[/p][p][/p][p]With less cost than a trip to the arcade at $14.99 USD you can own & play this meme-fueled arcade brawler game [i]Gorilla Smash[/i] on your PC game system.[/p][p][/p][p]"We wanted to create a fun simulation for the player to be able to play out the viral question of the moment with toughness and speed," said [b]Jae Woodward[/b], Co-Founder of LavaWorks. "[i]Gorilla Smash[/i] is the first game to launch in 2025 for the USA based gaming company that is working on industry trailblazing content soon to be released"[/p][p][/p][p]The game is offered in over 15 languages with enthusiasm reaching far and wide with pre sales interest seen across the world.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]LavaWorks release of Gorilla Smash is available for purchase on Steam on Thursday June 19th. Currently there is a free demo available up on [url="https://steampowered.com"]steampowered.com[/url] as well as a trailer.  Keep a look out for LavaWorks next release out later this year featuring a fantasy adventure game [/p][p][i]Flesh and Spirit.[/i][/p]
